title: The Unfinished Page
description: Two hands at one typewriter: one acts, one answers.

dialogue.speaker: The Page
dialogue.text: A sheet of paper, half-filled, ends mid-sentence: 'She opened the door and—'

dialogue.speaker: The Page
dialogue.text: Ink decides what happens. Echo decides what it means. The carriage waits.

dialogue.speaker: The Page
dialogue.text: —the rain came in sideways, and the candles went out all at once.

dialogue.speaker: The Page
dialogue.text: In the dark, the typing does not stop. Neither hand is willing to leave the sentence unfinished.

dialogue.speaker: The Page
dialogue.text: —the lamplight reached the hallway first, and nothing in it was frightening after all.

dialogue.speaker: The Page
dialogue.text: The page ends full. Two hands, one sentence, no signature.
